description: This file defines the MainActivity class, which is a ListActivity displaying a list of recipes. It handles list item clicks by starting RecipeActivity with the selected recipe name.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends ListActivity to display and handle interactions with a list of recipes.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on list items, logs the event, retrieves the item name, and starts RecipeActivity with the selected recipe.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, creates the adapter, and attaches it to the list view.
